# nadayantra


<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

A [FastHTML](https://fastht.ml) app. You teach it a few sounds, bind
each one to a glyph or key, and it types for you. Sounds are recognised
in-process by [nada](https://github.com/alix559/nada) (wav2vec 2.0 on
Modular MAX), with an [Observable
Framework](https://observablehq.com/framework/) frontend in `frontend/`.

## Install

``` sh
pixi install
```

`nada` is expected next to this repo (`../nada`), with its checkpoint in
`../nada/models`. Set `NADA_MODELS` to use a different directory.

## Run

``` sh
pixi run serve
```

The app listens on <http://localhost:5001>.

## Develop

This is an [nbdev](https://nbdev.fast.ai) project. Library code lives in
notebooks under `nbs/` and is exported to the `nadayantra` package:
`core`, `engine` (the nada model), `keys` (macOS keyboard access), `api`
(JSON for the frontend) and
[`main`](https://alix559.github.io/nadayantra/main.html#main) (the
FastHTML app). Edit the notebooks, never the exported `.py` files:

``` sh
pixi run nbdev-export
pixi run nbdev-test
```
